title: phlomis grandiflora var. fimbrilligera
intro: Phlomis grandiflora var. fimbrilligera, commonly known as a type of Jerusalem Sage, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. This herb has been traditionally used to support respiratory health, particularly in alleviating symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and colds. The therapeutic actions of Phlomis grandiflora var. fimbrilligera include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. Bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
